Commentary.Commentary: 190 to win then. The pitch is flat as a pancake but expect the Australian bowlers to be much better than the Bangladesh ones. And yes, fielding should be a good thing to watch too. Stay tuned.

Beth Mooney is down for an interview with Lisa Sthalekar. Mooney says that she loves playing at this ground. Adds that they lost their way in the middle as they tried to overhit the ball. Goes onto say that they are good players of spin and it is all in the mindset. Further says that she likes playing with Healy as she takes the pressure off.
A flat, very flat pitch. But that cannot be an excuse for poor bowling or fielding. Bangladesh simply did not turn up. Rumana Ahmed was the pick of the bowlers, but at an economy of 7.5.

Just the kind of game Healy and Mooney wanted. They were under the pump, after failing against India and Sri Lanka. But tonight, they came out all guns blazing, with plenty of runs from the opposition. Their 151-run stand is the best for Australia for the opening wicket in T20Is, second best ever in World Cups in this criteria and the 6th best first-wicket stand ever in Women's T20Is. Both batters played freely, swinging through the line, getting to the pitch of the ball. Both made a score in the region of the 80s but each would be happy with the returns. Towards the end, Ashleigh Gardner's cameo helped the home side a bit.

Make hay while the sun shines, is the statement. Australia made hay after the sun was set. They are playing Bangladesh for the first time in Women's T20Is and were given a pretty courteous welcome. Full tosses, looseners, dropped catches, misfields and what not. It was a buffet. In fact, Australia might be cursing themselves for not getting 200 on this deck and with such a bowling display.

NOT OUT! Missing the leg stump by a big margin! Slower full delivery down the leg side. Gardner is early into the shot as she looks to flick. She misses and gets hit on the pads. The Bangladesh players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. They opt for the review. The Ultra Edge shows that there is no bat on it and the Ball Tracker then rolls in which shows that is missing the leg stump. The ball rolls to the off side and the batters steal a leg bye. AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 189/1.
Bangladesh have gone for a review of the last ball. It looks not out. And it is. More of a review in desperation, with the ball projected to be missing leg stump.
FOUR! Full toss and it has been put away. Full toss on middle, Gardner hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.

Just short! Good length ball on middle, Gardner looks to heave it but it takes the top edge and goes way up in the air. The long on and the deep mid-wicket fielder run ahead but the ball falls short. The batters pick up a couple.
Low full toss on middle, Mooney looks to scoop it but it goes off the back of the bat and towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Very full delivery outside off, Mooney drives it to deep point and picks up a couple before the fielder comes across and cleans it up.
FOUR! The over starts in style. A full toss outside off, Mooney carves it over point and gets a boundary.

Dropped and six! Another chance goes begging! Bangladesh have been miserable in the field. Floated on off. Gardner comes down the track and then heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder stationed there settles herself but the ball pops out and over the fence. A six signaled.
Flighted outside off, Mooney dances down the track and then looks to drive but it takes the inside half of the bat and the ball goes towards long on for a single.
On off, pushed down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Nine of the first three balls! Flighted outside off, Gardner lifts this over the cover region and picks up a boundary.
FOUR! Hammered away! Short ball on middle, Gardner rocks on her back foot and then pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Full on middle, Gardner comes down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full delivery outside off, Gardner gets off the mark by driving this to long off for a single.
Very full delivery on off, Mooney digs it out to cover and takes a single.
FOUR! One bounce four! Short delivery on middle, Mooney moves to the off side and then scoops it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Landed outside off, Mooney looks to play this through the line but misses.
Comes down the track a touch, takes it on the full and whips it through square leg for a couple.
Full and outside off, Mooney looks to drive but misses.
Ashleigh Gardner walks in at number 3, replacing Healy.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, finally Bangladesh take the opportunity to take a wicket. There were already two dropped catches in the over and it is third time lucky. Another flat one outside off, Healy looks to cut but it goes uppishly towards the point region. Sanjida Islam does not have to move an inch as she takes the catch. Big relief for Bangladesh as Healy falls after playing a terrific knock. Can they restrict Australia to around 185?
Flatter one down the leg side, Mooney gets across and looks to scoop it but misses. The keeper fails to collect and the batters take a bye.

DROPPED! Another drop! Bangladesh are giving chances and chances to Australia. Flatter one outside off, Mooney looks to punch but it goes uppishly and towards point. The fielder dives to her left but fails to hold on. The ball rolls to deep point and the batters take a couple.

DROPPED! That should have been taken. Full and outside off, Healy comes down the track and swings hard. Gets a top edge which goes straight down the throat of short third man but she puts it down. A single taken.
Pushes this through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Mooney backs away and cuts it over point for a boundary. She moves to 63 in 46 balls.
Salma Khatun returns. 2-0-15-0 so far.
Top edge but safe! Floated outside off, Healy looks to lift it but it takes the top edge but it lands safely over the extra cover fielder. Two taken.

EDGY FOUR! Full outside off, Healy looks to drive but it takes the inside edge and goes towards fine leg. The keeper looks to chase after it but then sees the short fine leg fielder going after it. The fine leg fielder runs across and dives but the ball still touches the ropes.
FOUR! Nicely played! Loopy one on middle, Healy lifts it towards the long on region. The fielder comes across but the ball goes past her and into the fence.
Loopy one on middle, Healy defends it out after coming down the pitch.
Floated outside off, Mooney drives it to deep cover for a single.

DROPPED! When these chances come your way, it has to be taken. Bangladesh though do not take it and give an opportunity to Mooney. Floated outside off, Mooney dances down the track and then looks to lift it over long off. The fielder comes across from long off, tumbles but fails to hold onto the catch.
Nahida Akter is back on.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mooney plays it to deep cover for a single.
Floated on off, Healy comes down the track and drives it to long off for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. They pick up a single.
FOUR! This is now the highest opening partnership for Australia in T20Is. Full on middle, Mooney goes on her knees and reverse sweeps it to the third man region for a boundary.
Tossed up ball outside off, Healy lifts it towards long off for a single.
WIDE! Flighted ball down the leg side, Healy looks to sweep but misses. Wide signaled.
FIFTY! Mooney follows her partner's footsteps as he gets to her fifty now. Very good innings so far from Mooney. Flighted ball outside off, Beth drives it to deep cover for a single.
Full and outside off, Mooney comes down the track and drives it to long off. There is a thought about the second but they settle for one. Another good over for Bangladesh.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
And again. Down the pitch, getting to the ball and driving. Through the covers for one more. Healy moves 30 short of what could be the best possible chance of getting a century.
Floated this time, outside off, now Mooney steps out and drives it through the covers for a run.
Tossed up outside off, Alyssa comes down the track and lofts it down to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, Healy comes down the track and steers it straight to short third man.

NOT OUT! Mooney has done really well to get her bat down in time. Was the keeper slow in whipping the bails off? Flighted ball outside off. Mooney dances down the track and looks to heave it to the leg side but misses. Nigar Sultana collects it and whips the bails off. Mooney takes her time to get her bat down and she looks gone for all money. The third umpire is called for and the replay shows that Mooney had somehow managed to get her bat down in time! Lucky for Beth or was the keeper too slow?
A stumping! Is it? Referred upstairs. Looks gone. Wait. The bat has come down in time!
Low full toss on middle, Healy flicks it to the deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Healy looks to heave it away but gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, Mooney drives it to deep cover for a single.
Full outside off, Healy drives it to the off side for a single.
Flighted outside off, Mooney looks to drive but it takes the inside edge and rolls towards square leg. A single taken.
Rumana Ahmed returns. 2-0-16-0 so far.
Full on middle, Beth makes room and then drives it to long off to keep strike for the next over.
Short ball outside off, Healy punches it to deep cover for a single.
Outside off, Mooney drives it down to long off for a single.

Australian assistant coach, Ben Sawyer, is down for a chat with Lisa Sthalekar. Sawyer says that Alyssa Healy is very much focussed during training, even though she has missed out in this tournament. Feels that she is in the mood tonight. Is happy that Australia are bating first as he reckons that they usually like to bat first, get a total on the board and then defend the same.
Floated on off, Mooney pushes it to the mid off fielder.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! Healy dances down the pitch, converting this ball to a full toss. She flicks it to the deep square leg region where the fielder comes across from deep mid-wicket. She dives but fails to make the stop. Boundary signaled. Healy becomes the highest run-scorer of the tournament.
Fullish delivery outside off, Healy drives it to cover where the fielder makes a half stop allowing the batters to take a single.
On middle, Mooney drives it striahgt past the bowler and crosses over for a single.
FOUR! No fielder in the deep. 100-run partnership comes up as well. Fullish on the pads, Mooney flicks it to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Length ball on off, Alyssa pushes it to cover and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Healy would have been in though.
Low full toss outside off, Healy misses out as she drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Play and a miss! Alam starts with a fullish delivery outside off, Healy looks to drive without moving her feet and fails to get any bat on it.
Jahanara Alam is back on. Her first over cost 12 runs.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for another brace. 11 from the over, 38 from the last 3!
FOUR! Great shot. Full and outside off, Mooney comes down the track and lofts it straight, beating long off's dive to her left!
Comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it wide of long off or a couple. The throw comes in to the bowler who turns and fires a direct hit at her end but Healy is well in.
Slowly tossed up outside off, short in length, Beth goes back, waits and pulls it straight to short mid-wicket.

Short and outside off, Mooney rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket. The mid on fielder gets across to get left and dives but the ball goes beneath her. It almost makes it to  the fence but deep mid-wicket dives to her right and stops the boundary. Two runs taken.
Short and in line of the stumps, punched through the covers for a single.
Fahima Khatun into the attack now.
Short ball outside off, Healy punches it to deep cover for a single.
Just short! Short delivery on middle, Healy pulls it wide of long on. Alam moves across from long on and tumbles. The ball falls short but Alam does well to stop the ball. Another two runs.
On off, pushed to mid off for a single.
FOUR! Not well timed but still fetches Mooney a boundary. Floated outside off, Mooney prods forward and lifts it wide of mid off for a boundary.
Floated on off, Mooney lifts it over the bowler's head. The mid on fielder comes across and cleans it up. She throws it to the bowler who tries to parry it back to the stumps but misses. Two taken.
Full on middle, Healy plays it to long on for a single.
Flighted on off, Healy drives it to long off for a single.
Mooney comes down the track, converts this ball to a full toss and drives it to long off for a single.
Flighted on middle, Healy flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Consecutive maximums! What a way to get your fifty! Healy is roaring back to form in this World Cup. This is turning out to be a brilliant innings from the opener/keeper. Loopy on middle, Healy goes on her knees and slog sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket region for a biggie.

SIX! Just over the long off fielder! Floated outside off, Mooney dances down the track and lifts it over the long off fielder for a biggie. The fielder was interested for a while but it goes just over her head.
Short one outside off, Mooney pushes it to the deep cover region for another run.
FOUR! Hammered! Flighted on middle, Healy moves a bit forward and then lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full on middle, Healy flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full on middle, Healy pushes it back to the bowler.
Missed out! Flatter one outside off, Healy punches but it goes straight to the cover fielder.
Flighted outside off, Mooney prods forward and drives it to deep cover for a single.
Tosses this one up outside off, Mooney pushes it to cover.
Rumana Ahmed is into the attack.
Outside off, Mooney lunges and drives it to long off for a single. Excellent Powerplay for Australia. 53/0 after the first 6 overs.
Flighted ball on off, Healy guides it to short third man for a single.
SIX! 50-run opening stand comes up in some style! Looped up ball on middle, Healy dances down the track and lifts it over the wide long on region for a maximum.
Good running! Floated on middle, Mooney taps it to cover and takes off for a quick single. The fielder runs ahead and then has a shy at the keeper's end. He misses but it would not have mattered.
FOUR! Hammered down the ground! Flighted outside off, Mooney dances down and plays it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, Mooney cuts it to point.
Khadija Tul Kubra into the attack. An offie.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mooney drives it to long off for a single.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! For the first time, Australia's batting is looking good. They are not struggling against spin and this is turning out to be a terrific start! Floated outside off, Healy uses the feet and lifts it over the cover region for a boundary.
Full on middle, Healy dances down and then looks to flick. It takes the inside edge and hits the pads. No harm done.
Full around off, Mooney drives it to long on and crosses over for a single.
Tossed up ball outside off, Mooney uses her feet and then drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Loopy one outside off, Mooney takes a long stride forward and then drives it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter outside off, Mooney punches it to cover.
Outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
Full on middle, Alyssa uses her feet and then pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Whacked! Flighted ball on off, Healy puts on her dancing shoes and then hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Flatter one outside off, Mooney punches it to the deep cover region for a single.
Full on middle, Mooney drives it to long on to keep strike for the next over.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet! Tossed up outside off, Mooney comes down the pitch and lifts it over the cover region for a boundary. First one for her.
Looped up ball on off, Mooney defends it off the front foot. They think of a run but decide against it in the end.
Healy comes down the track and then converts this ball to a full toss. Flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter one on middle, Healy looks to defend but it takes the inside edge and goes towards the leg side.
Floated on middle, Healy flicks it to mid-wicket.
Nahida Akter is into the attack.
Floated on off, Mooney defends it to cover. 8 from the skipper's first.
Loopy one outside off, Healy dances down the track and drives it to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Healy is off to a flier! Fourth boundary already for her! Shortish outside off, Healy moves inside her crease and then drives it to the deep cover region for a boundary.
Shorter outside off, Healy punches it to cover for a dot.
Shorter one outside off, Mooney pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Khatun starts with a flatter one outside off, Mooney punches it to the deep point region and picks up a couple before the fielder comes across and cleans it up.
Salma Khatun, the skipper will bowl from the other end.
Outside off, driven to cover. Good start for Australia. 12 from the first over.
FOUR! Punched! Shortish outside off, Healy punches it towards point where the fielder dives but the ball goes past him and into the deep point fence. Three boundaries already.
On a length outside off, Healy punches it to cover.

FOUR! Nice fielding attempt! Short ball outside off, Healy cuts it uppishly in the gap through point. The fielder from sweeper comes across and dives to her left but the ball goes beneath her and touches the ropes. 8 already off the first three balls.
Good length ball outside off, Healy this time leaves the ball alone.
FOUR! What a way to start the innings! Perfect start! Full delivery outside off, swinging away, Healy leans and drives it through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Both the sides are out in the field to stand in respect of their respective National Anthems. Bangladesh's National Anthem is up first followed by Australia's. Jahanara Alam will start with the ball.

Pitch report - Alan Wilkins is down near the pitch, he says that the shortest boundary is 57m and the straight hit is 67m. He is joined by Michael Clarke, who says that the Australian batters struggled against the spin and that will have a major impact on this wicket and the Australian batters will have to use their feet well to counter that.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Murshida Khatun, Shamima Sultana, Sanjida Islam, Nigar Sultana (WK), Fargana Hoque, Rumana Ahmed, Salma Khatun (C), Fahima Khatun, Jahanara Alam, Khadija Tul Kubra (In place of Panna Ghosh), Nahida Akter.

Australia (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Ashleigh Gardner, Meg Lanning (C), Ellyse Perry, Rachael Haynes, Nicola Carey, Jess Jonassen, Georgia Wareham (In place of Delissa Kimmince), Annabel Sutherland (In place of Molly Strano), Megan Schutt.
Salma Khatun, the Bangladesh skipper, says that they would have bowled first and they are excited to be playing against Australia for the first time. Says that they have made a single change.

Meg Lanning, the Australian skipper, says that they will bat first as it is generally a good batting deck in Canberra. States they have not played against Bangladesh and praises them for playing well against India.
Toss - Australia have won the toss and they choose to bat.

We have just finished with a thriller of a game between India and New Zealand and now it's time for the second game of the day, Australia and Bangladesh. The Aussies are coming off a much-needed win against Sri Lanka and they would hope to continue the momentum. Their opponents, Bangladesh, on the other hand, need to start winning if they want to stand a chance but they face a strong opponent and it will not be easy. Will the Aussies achieve back-to-back wins or will Bangladesh pull an upset out of the hat? Join us in a while for the toss and team updates.
